cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(test_openwriter C)

# abiword-plugin-openwriter is autotools-only; no upstream CMake config.
# Use CMakeDeps generated by conan to locate libgsf-1 + glib.
#
# Actual dependencies (verified against conandata.yml 2026-08-10):
#   - gsf/1.14.53    → libgsf::libgsf-1   (component target name = "libgsf-1")
#   - glib/2.72.4    → glib::glib           (from libgsf's conandata.yml transitive)
# Note: the "team registry" 1.14.58 / 2.84.0 versions in earlier revisions
# were placeholders that did not match the actual conan build graph. The
# 1.14.53 alignment is the regression fix shipped in commit a5a3bd37c2.
find_package(libgsf REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(glib REQUIRED CONFIG)

add_executable(test_openwriter test_openwriter.c)

# Resolve libgsf-1.cmake component explicitly. The component name comes
# from libgsf's CMakeDeps config (recipe name + component = "libgsf-1"),
# not a single-target "libgsf-1::libgsf-1" name (that was an error in the
# previous revision — components with hyphens need the recipe namespace).
target_link_libraries(test_openwriter
    libgsf::libgsf-1
    glib::glib
)

# Include-dir fallback: if the conan CMakeDeps config didn't expose
# INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES for any dep (known conan 2.0-2.2 issue
# with GLOB-detected headers), locate the headers in the conan cache
# directly. We scope by *exact* package hash path under p/b/ to avoid
# accidentally matching the wrong gsf version when multiple are cached.
if(NOT DEFINED CONAN_HOME)
    if(DEFINED ENV{CONAN_HOME})
        set(CONAN_HOME $ENV{CONAN_HOME})
    elseif(DEFINED ENV{HOME})
        set(CONAN_HOME $ENV{HOME}/.conan2)
    else()
        set(CONAN_HOME "")
    endif()
endif()

# The GLOB patterns below were the source of the original "match any
# gsf package" bug (C4 fix). We now require the versioned package id
# directory — if it doesn't exist, skip silently rather than abbrev-match
# a wrong version. Conan 2.x stores resolved packages under
# ~/.conan2/p/b/<pkgid>/p/ where pkgid is a content-addressed hash;
# iterating via CONAN_HOME/p/b/* and filtering by include-dir presence
# is more portable than guessing the pkgid prefix.
set(_INCLUDE_DIRS_FIXED "")

# glib needs include/glib-2.0 (glib.h) and lib/glib-2.0/include (glibconfig.h).
# libgsf needs include/libgsf-1/gsf/ (gsf.h).
# C2 fix from AI review round 4: conan 2.1+ stores packages under p/<name>*
# (recipe-name keyed) AND legacy 2.0.x used p/b/<pkgid>*. Match both to
# support both layouts during a multi-host CI migration.
file(GLOB _GLIB_INC_DIRS LIST_DIRECTORIES true
    "${CONAN_HOME}/p/b/glib*/p/include/glib-2.0"
    "${CONAN_HOME}/p/glib*/p/include/glib-2.0")
file(GLOB _GLIB_CFG_DIRS LIST_DIRECTORIES true
    "${CONAN_HOME}/p/b/glib*/p/lib/glib-2.0/include"
    "${CONAN_HOME}/p/glib*/p/lib/glib-2.0/include")
file(GLOB _LIBGSF_INC_DIRS LIST_DIRECTORIES true
    "${CONAN_HOME}/p/b/gsf*/p/include/libgsf-1"
    "${CONAN_HOME}/p/gsf*/p/include/libgsf-1")

# Only use the first match per dep (semver-conflict safety).
foreach(_DEPS IN ITEMS _GLIB_INC_DIRS _GLIB_CFG_DIRS _LIBGSF_INC_DIRS)
    list(LENGTH ${_DEPS} _LEN)
    if(_LEN GREATER 1)
        message(WARNING "test_openwriter: multiple ${_DEPS} matches; "
                "using first. Clear stale conan cache if wrong version is chosen.")
        list(GET ${_DEPS} 0 _FIRST)
        set(${_DEPS} "${_FIRST}")
    endif()
endforeach()

# After target_link_libraries so INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES are
# applied via the link transitive. The fallback dirs are added only
# if the target's own include dirs don't already contain the headers.
get_target_property(_HAS_GLIB libgsf::libgsf-1 INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
if(_HAS_GLIB)
    target_include_directories(test_openwriter PRIVATE
        ${_GLIB_INC_DIRS}
        ${_GLIB_CFG_DIRS}
        ${_LIBGSF_INC_DIRS})
    message(STATUS "test_openwriter: applied conan-cache include-dir fallback")
endif()

enable_testing()
# WORKING_DIRECTORY ensures /tmp/test_openwriter_* is created in a
# writable location even when CTest is invoked from a stripped CI sandbox.
add_test(NAME test_openwriter COMMAND test_openwriter WORKING_DIRECTORY /tmp)
